Incident Type: VESSEL

SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.702222, -70.368056 (Explicit)
Reported Sheen Size: 60 feet by 60 feet (area 3600 sq. ft.)
SkyTruth Minimum Estimate: 0.09 gallons
Report DescriptionREPORT RECEIVED FROM NATIONAL COMMAND CENTER... USCG SECTOR SOUTHEAST NEW ENGLAND RECEIVED A MAYDAY CALL VIA VHF CH 16 THAT THE 75" FISHING VESSEL (F/V) REBECCA MARY, WAS SINKING 40 NAUTICAL MILES SOUTH OF MARTHA"S VINEYARD, MA. FOUR PERSONS ENTERED THE WATER IN SURVIVAL SUITS AND EPIRB WAS ACTIVATED. USCG STATION MENEMSHA , USCG STATION BRANT POINT, AND AIR STATION CAPE COD WERE LAUNCHED. ALL FOUR PERSONS WERE SAFELY HOISTED BY AN HH-60 HELICOPTER FROM AIR STATION CAPE COD WITH NO MEDICAL CONCERNS NOTED. DRUG AND ALCOHOL TESTING IS SCHEDULED FOR LATER TODAY. THE INCIDENT WAS DEEMED A MAJOR MARINE CASUALTY DUE TO VESSEL'S ESTIMATED VALUE OF OVER $800,000. SOME SHEENING WAS OBSERVED. THE POLLUTION POTENTIAL IS 4,000 GALLONS AND AN OVERFLIGHT IS SCHEDULED FOR LATER TODAY. *AN URGENT MARINE INFORMATION BROADCAST (UMIB) WAS ISSUED IN ADDITION TO A SAFETY MARINE INFORMATION BROADCAST (SMIB) FOR A PARTIALLY SUBMERGED VESSEL. THERE IS NO LOCAL OR NATIONAL MEDIA ATTENTION AT THIS TIME. THE CIC PROCESS WAS STOOD DOWN. THE NATIONAL COMMAND CENTER CONFIRMED THAT THE POLLUTION POTENTIAL IS FROM DIESEL FUEL. SECTOR SOUTHERN NEW ENGLAND CONFIRMED THE VESSEL"S COORDINATES.
